d:
In the second episode of Lion from executive producer and Lion King director Jon Favreau and National Geographic, 12-week-old lion cub Kio must earn the respect of his older brothers if he’s ever to survive – and one day become a king. Just as he finally finds his place among them, disaster strikes the pride, forcing Summer to make an extraordinary sacrifice to protect Kio’s future. Witness Kio's journey in becoming a real lion king.
Lion | S1, E2
